description: This is a test class for the TagService component in the backend of a book tracking application. It includes unit tests for methods such as findById, findByName, findAll, save, count, delete, and deleteAll, utilizing Mockito for mocking dependencies and AssertJ for assertions.

classes.name: TagServiceTest
classes.description: Unit testing class for TagService, verifying behavior of tag operations such as retrieval, saving, and deletion.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock dependencies and the TagService instance before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsNullPointerException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Tests that findById throws NullPointerException when null is passed.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Verifies that findById correctly calls the repository when given a valid ID.

methods.name: findByName_throwsNullPointerException_ifNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that findByName throws NullPointerException when null is passed.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullName
methods.description: Verifies that findByName correctly calls the repository when given a valid name.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that findAll calls the repository's findAll method.

methods.name: save_throwsNullPointerException_ifTagIsNull
methods.description: Tests that save throws NullPointerException when null is passed.

methods.name: tagNotSavedIfTagNameTaken
methods.description: Ensures that a tag is not saved if a tag with the same name already exists.

methods.name: tagSavedIfTagNameNotTaken
methods.description: Ensures that a tag is saved when the name is not already taken.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies that count calls the repository's count method.

methods.name: delete_throwsNullPointerException_ifTagIsNull
methods.description: Tests that delete throws NullPointerException when null is passed.

methods.name: canDeleteNonNullTag
methods.description: Verifies that delete calls the repository's delete method with a valid Tag.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Verifies that deleteAll calls the repository's deleteAll method.
